verdict.rationale: Plausible offers scheduled email/Slack reports for dashboard subscription and explicit 'traffic spike notifications' for anomaly alerting, which covers the core of the story. However, evidence only shows spike/drop alerts tied to traffic volume, not configurable alerts for arbitrary key metrics (e.g., conversion rate, revenue) with custom thresholds. Missing for 10: evidence of alerting on metrics beyond traffic (e.g., goal conversions, revenue), configurable alert thresholds, and independent/hands-on confirmation that alerts work reliably.
